profile.headline: Lead Principal Software Engineer at Akamai Technologies
profile.summary:
- Strong experience in design and implementation of systems for a variety of programming challenges. I have had to evaluate and implement a large number of technology patterns.

- A strong belief that anything can be solved given time, a correct mind set, and drive.

- Possesses management skills.  I've had to work teach and direct junior level coders as well as serve as a Team lead.

- System design, deployment and implementation is one of my passions.

---------------------------------
Technical Expertise
----------------------------------

- Programming Languages: Python(9 years), Go(3 years), Perl(12 years), Javascript(12 years), C(primarily used with XS to speed up Perl Code), PHP5(2 years), Lua(2 year), Java(primarily academic), C#(1 year)

- Other Languages: SQL

- Programming Frameworks/Toolkits: Django, Gevent, AngularJS, POE, DBIx::Class, Rose::DB::Object, Catalyst,Template Toolkit, Dojo Javascript tool-kit, YUI Javascript tool-kit, Xapian search, Jinja Templating, wxPython

- Programming Concepts: Concurrency, Distributed causality, Language Parsing including NLP, AJAX(including cross domain), MVC, ORM, Development life cycle(Gathering system requirements, High Level design, Unit and System level Testing

- Operating Systems: Linux(Redhat and Ubuntu distros), Windows(XP, Vista and 7) and OS X

- Databases: Postgresql, MySQL, MongoDB and Riak, Tokyo Cabinet

- Other Systems/Software: RabbitMQ, Gearman, Jenkins, Apache, MogileFS, Perlbal, Memcached, OpenVZ, Spread Messaging Toolkit

- Paradigms: Concurrency, Distributed causality, OOP(Design Patterns, Re-factoring), Network programming(event driven and fork-on accept), Functional programming, Cooperative Multitasking, Consistent Hashing, Sharding, Replication, Scalable System Implementation, Test driven design, Code optimization using profiling and bench marking, Language parsing including light NLP work

- Familiar Programming tools: Vim, Eclipse, PyCharm, Subversion, Mercurial, Git, CVS
